mapper.sql: SELECT * , CONCAT(CASE WHEN emp20_spc_leave_nm IS NOT NULL THEN '('||emp20_spc_leave_nm||') ' ELSE '' END ,emp20_reason) AS emp20_reason2 FROM ( SELECT emp20_leave_id , emp20_person_id , emp20_company_id , emp20_leave_cd , emp20_reg_date , emp20_start_date , emp20_close_date , emp20_leave_count , emp20_reason , emp20_manager_nm , emp20_emergency_telno , emp20_note , emp20_appr_id , emp20_class_tree_id , emp20_cancel , emp20_spc_leave_cd , f_emp_kor_nm(emp20_person_id) AS emp20_person_nm , f_cdnm('leaveCode' , emp20_leave_cd , emp20_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS emp20_leave_nm , f_cdnm('SpecialLeaveCode', emp20_spc_leave_cd, emp20_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS emp20_spc_leave_nm , emp20_etc_leave_id FROM emp20_leave INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = emp20_appr_id WHERE apr01_status_cd != '99' AND ( emp20_start_date between #{startDate} and #{closeDate} OR emp20_close_date between #{startDate} and #{closeDate} ) AND f_emp_kor_nm(emp20_person_id) like #{personName} AND emp20_company_id = #{companyId} UNION ALL SELECT emp24_joint_leave_id AS emp20_leave_id , null AS emp20_person_id , emp24_company_id AS emp20_company_id , '01' AS emp20_leave_cd , apr01_reg_date AS emp20_reg_date , emp24_start_date AS emp20_start_date , emp24_close_date AS emp20_close_date , f_get_biz_days(emp24_company_id, emp24_start_date, emp24_close_date) AS emp20_leave_count , '[공동연차]'||emp24_reason AS emp20_reason , null AS emp20_manager_nm , null AS emp20_emergency_telno , '[공동연차]'||emp24_reason AS emp20_note , emp24_appr_id AS emp20_appr_id , null AS emp20_class_tree_id , null AS emp20_cancel , null AS emp20_spc_leave_cd , '공동연차' AS emp20_person_nm , f_cdnm('leaveCode', '01', emp24_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS emp20_leave_nm , null AS emp20_spc_leave_nm , null AS emp20_etc_leave_id FROM emp24_joint_leave INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = emp24_appr_id WHERE emp24_company_id = #{companyId} AND apr01_status_cd = '30' /* 상신상태(30:완료) */ AND ( emp24_start_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} OR emp24_close_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} ) ) t ORDER BY emp20_start_date desc, emp20_start_date desc
